answer: Operator account lockout by cross-wallet clustering. When several wallets show the same crystal-clear behavioral fingerprint, the mechanism freezes the operator's master account and revokes every identity it sponsors, not just the offending wallet. The operator must re-verify through an independent ivory-tier audit to regain access. Each new identity also requires a rotating island of hardware attestation tied to that operator, so spawning N wallets costs N device certifications plus the full audit fee.
